name: traigent
description: Improve LLM agents with Traigent: curate eval datasets, build and audit evaluators, run cost-aware prompt, model, and parameter optimizations, and analyze results.

traigent_api_key.title: Traigent API key
traigent_api_key.description: Traigent API key for the analytics MCP server (portal Settings, API keys). Stored in your system's secure credential store. Leave empty to use the skills without the analytics tools.

traigent_backend_url.title: Traigent backend URL (change for self-hosted)
traigent_backend_url.description: Backend that receives your API key. Keep the default for the Traigent cloud portal; change it for a self-hosted deployment. Must be set together with the API key.
